# One Way Door Product Chain

Amazon Working Backwards requirements chain with review gates and quality rubrics: press → faq → mrd → prd → narrative-6p → uxd

Generated from the visionspec `aws-one-way-door` workflow family. Regenerate with `visionspec speckit export aws-one-way-door`; do not edit by hand.

## Install

```bash
specify extension add one-way-door --dev <path-to-this-directory>
```

## Commands

- `/speckit.one-way-door.press` — The founding artifact: human-authored press release announcing the customer experience.
- `/speckit.one-way-door.faq` — Stress-tests the press release.
- `/speckit.one-way-door.mrd` — Optional market validation deepening the FAQ's business-case answers with evidence (typical at product scale)
- `/speckit.one-way-door.prd` — Author the Product Requirements (PRD) document for this initiative
- `/speckit.one-way-door.narrative-6p` — Author the Six-Pager Decision Narrative document for this initiative
- `/speckit.one-way-door.uxd` — Author the User Experience Design (UXD) document for this initiative

Documents are written to `.specify/initiatives/<slug>/` in chain order: press → faq → mrd → prd → narrative-6p → uxd.
